result.description:
Who we are 


Our mission is to develop services to enhance the quality of life and meet individual outcomes. 
Specialising in 24-hour disability programs for individuals with multiple and complex needs, we are proud to be a trusted and registered service provider with the NDIA. 
We enable our people to provide the best possible care to our clients by continuously investing in their learning, development, and well-being. 
We are committed to developing a culture that lives by the One Doorway (Logos Care Pty Ltd) values: inclusiveness, respect, diversity, and equality. 


Your role 


As a Disability Support Worker with One Doorway, you will be responsible for providing person-centred care and support for people with disabilities in the home and community.  You will also work with other health professionals to maximise the individual's physical and mental well-being.

We are looking for experienced and dedicated Support Workers to provide assistance and support to individuals with complex needs. This role focuses on providing high-intensity support to participants with complex and multiple support requirements, encouraging their independence and self-determination.


How will you make an impact 

Support participants to meet their goals, particularly in alignment with their NDIS plan, with a focus on safety, dignity, and client goals.
Provide in-home support with health requirements, personal care, and daily living tasks in alignment with the participant's needs and the Care Team support requirements
Assist with the delivery of activities to enhance the development of capacity and skills across physical, social, emotional, and intellectual domains
Work with a team of health professionals, family, friends, and carers to implement a program of support, including the implementation of Behaviour Support Plans and other Allied Health Plans
Respond to crisis situations, including behaviours of concern as listed in the Behaviour Support Plan
Prepare meals and ensure dietary needs are met.
Promoting independent living
Optional and, where required, provide:
Assistance with medication administration, as per policy, procedures and health professional directions
Manual handling assistance - training will be provided when required
Behavioural and Mental Health Support
Provide 1:1 support to a client with complex needs, including seizure management (e.g., oral suction, medication administration) and personal care (e.g., hygiene, mobility).
Ensure all documentation required by One Doorway when supporting a participant is completed promptly and to a high standard
Advocate for participants and empower participants with choice and control
Comply with One Doorway Policies and Procedures as applicable to your role
Attend and participate in team meetings and other meetings as requested
Actively engage in creating a safe work environment through identifying, reporting and when appropriate, mitigating risk and hazards
Other duties as required by the business

Who you work with 

Our people leaders, our employees, and your colleagues in the Operations team 
Government & community organisations, health professionals, family, friends, and carers
 

Why join One Doorway

Great Pay: $76,515 - $79,499 per annum plus super if you hold a relevant Certificate III or higher qualification in Disability, Individual Support, or Community Services.
Flexible Hours: Weekdays, weekends, mornings, evenings — we'll work around your schedule.
Ongoing Training: Regular professional development to build your skills and confidence.
Supportive Culture: Be part of a values-driven team that's inclusive, transparent, and collaborative.
 

What we are looking for 

We are looking for compassionate and empathetic support workers looking to make a difference in people’s lives. You must have experience with participants who have high needs and complex behaviour, and must have good communication skills.  
Commitment to the rights of people with disabilities to live dignified lives
You'll need to be a detail-oriented individual who possesses strong listening and communication skills to be successful.
Able to accept responsibility and work as part of a team
Patient, flexible, understanding, supportive and caring nature
Strong computer, written and verbal communication skills

Desirable,

Experience working within the disability or health care sectors
Certificate III or Certificate IV in Individual Support or Mental Health or equivalent
At least 1 year of relevant work experience.
Valid driver’s licence
Access to a comprehensively insured vehicle

We are deeply committed to keeping our clients safe, and so we require all One Doorway people to hold 

Proof of working rights in Australia 
NDIS Worker Screening Clearance issued in the State of Victoria 
Employee Working with Children Check card issued in the State of Victoria 
Full COVID vaccinations (3-doses) 

To apply online, please click on the appropriate link below.
